name: RenownOrganization
description: A Renown organisation: profile, members and roles, teams, apps, domains and credential suspensions; the signed record mirror of the renown-orgs store

global.schema:
type RenownOrganizationState {
  "Lowercase; unique across users and organizations (enforced by the write path)"
  handle: String
  "1-64 characters"
  name: String
  "At most 280 characters"
  bio: String
  "An http(s) URL"
  website: String
  "attachment://v1:<sha256>"
  avatar: String
  "At most 8, in display order"
  links: [RenownOrgLink!]!
  "Opted in to the organization directory"
  listed: Boolean!
  "Active, non-hidden members are shown publicly"
  membersPublic: Boolean!
  archived: Boolean!
  takenDown: Boolean!
  "Lowercase address of the creator; set once by INIT_ORGANIZATION"
  createdBy: EthereumAddress
  "Every membership record ever created (rows are never removed)"
  members: [RenownOrgMember!]!
  "At most 50 flat teams"
  teams: [RenownOrgTeam!]!
  apps: [RenownOrgApp!]!
  domains: [RenownOrgDomain!]!
  "Delegation credential ids suspended by the organization"
  suspendedCredentialIds: [String!]!
}

type RenownOrgLink {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  url: String!
}

enum RenownOrgRole {
  OWNER
  ADMIN
  PUBLISHER
  MEMBER
}

enum RenownOrgMemberStatus {
  INVITED
  ACTIVE
  DECLINED
  LEFT
  REMOVED
  REVOKED
}

type RenownOrgAppScope {
  all: Boolean!
  appDids: [String!]!
}

type RenownOrgMember {
  id: OID!
  "Lowercase"
  address: EthereumAddress!
  role: RenownOrgRole!
  status: RenownOrgMemberStatus!
  appScope: RenownOrgAppScope!
  hidden: Boolean!
  joinedAt: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

type RenownOrgTeam {
  id: OID!
  slug: String!
  name: String!
  appDids: [String!]!
  memberIds: [OID!]!
}

type RenownOrgApp {
  appDid: String!
  addedAt: DateTime!
  frozen: Boolean!
}

enum RenownOrgDomainStatus {
  PENDING
  VERIFIED
  LAPSED
}

type RenownOrgDomain {
  id: OID!
  domain: String!
  status: RenownOrgDomainStatus!
  verifiedAt: DateTime
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "handle": null,
  "name": null,
  "bio": null,
  "website": null,
  "avatar": null,
  "links": [],
  "listed": false,
  "membersPublic": false,
  "archived": false,
  "takenDown": false,
  "createdBy": null,
  "members": [],
  "teams": [],
  "apps": [],
  "domains": [],
  "suspendedCredentialIds": []
}

operations.name: INIT_ORGANIZATION
operations.description: Sets handle, name and creator once, when the organization is created

errors.name: AlreadyInitializedError
errors.description: INIT_ORGANIZATION already ran

errors.name: InvalidHandleError
errors.description: The handle does not match ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9])$

errors.name: NameLengthError
errors.description: The name is not 1-64 characters without surrounding whitespace

operations.name: SET_ORG_PROFILE
operations.description: Patches the profile: null or absent keeps a field, an empty string clears bio/website/avatar, links replaces the whole list

errors.name: BioTooLongError
errors.description: The bio is longer than 280 characters

errors.name: InvalidWebsiteError
errors.description: The website is not an http(s) URL of at most 2048 characters

errors.name: InvalidAvatarError
errors.description: The avatar is not an attachment://v1:<sha256> reference

errors.name: TooManyLinksError
errors.description: More than 8 links

errors.name: InvalidLinkError
errors.description: A link has a duplicate id, a label outside 1-40 characters or a non-http(s) URL

operations.name: SET_ORG_HANDLE
operations.description: Changes the handle (uniqueness is checked by the write path)

operations.name: SET_ORG_LISTED
operations.description: Opts in to or out of the organization directory

operations.name: SET_MEMBERS_PUBLIC
operations.description: Shows or hides the member list publicly

operations.name: ARCHIVE_ORG
operations.description: Archives the organization: unlisted, open invites revoked, active members removed

operations.name: SET_TAKEN_DOWN
operations.description: Platform moderation: takes the organization down or restores it

operations.name: INVITE_MEMBER
operations.description: Creates an INVITED membership record

errors.name: DuplicateMemberError
errors.description: The id is used, or the address already has an INVITED or ACTIVE record

operations.name: SET_MEMBER_STATUS
operations.description: Moves a membership record through its lifecycle

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: No membership record with this id

errors.name: InvalidStatusTransitionError
errors.description: Only INVITED to ACTIVE/DECLINED/REVOKED and ACTIVE to LEFT/REMOVED are allowed

errors.name: LastOwnerError
errors.description: The change would leave the organization without an active owner

errors.name: TooManyMembersError
errors.description: The organization already has 500 active members

operations.name: SET_MEMBER_ROLE
operations.description: Changes the role of an INVITED or ACTIVE member

errors.name: MemberNotActiveError
errors.description: The membership record is not INVITED or ACTIVE (not ACTIVE for team membership)

operations.name: SET_MEMBER_APP_SCOPE
operations.description: Sets the apps a publisher or member acts for

errors.name: InvalidAppDidError
errors.description: An app DID is not a did:key, or there are more than 200

operations.name: SET_MEMBER_HIDDEN
operations.description: The member hides or shows their membership publicly

operations.name: ADD_TEAM
operations.description: Adds a flat team

errors.name: DuplicateTeamIdError
errors.description: The team id is used

errors.name: TooManyTeamsError
errors.description: The organization already has 50 teams

errors.name: InvalidTeamError
errors.description: The slug or name is malformed

errors.name: DuplicateTeamSlugError
errors.description: Another team has this slug

operations.name: UPDATE_TEAM
operations.description: Patches a team: null or absent keeps a field

errors.name: TeamNotFoundError
errors.description: No team with this id

operations.name: REMOVE_TEAM
operations.description: Removes a team

operations.name: SET_TEAM_MEMBERS
operations.description: Replaces a team's members (ACTIVE membership ids)

operations.name: ADD_ORG_APP
operations.description: Records an app the organization owns

errors.name: InvalidAppDidError
errors.description: The app DID is not a did:key

errors.name: DuplicateAppError
errors.description: The app already belongs to the organization

operations.name: REMOVE_ORG_APP
operations.description: Removes an app (transferred out)

errors.name: AppNotFoundError
errors.description: The app does not belong to the organization

operations.name: SET_APP_FROZEN
operations.description: Freezes or unfreezes an org app

operations.name: ADD_DOMAIN
operations.description: Adds a PENDING domain

errors.name: InvalidDomainError
errors.description: Not a lowercase DNS name with at least two labels

errors.name: DuplicateDomainError
errors.description: The id or the domain is already present

operations.name: SET_DOMAIN_STATUS
operations.description: Records a verification result

errors.name: DomainNotFoundError
errors.description: No domain with this id

operations.name: REMOVE_DOMAIN
operations.description: Removes a domain

operations.name: SUSPEND_CREDENTIALS
operations.description: Suspends delegation credentials for org apps

operations.name: UNSUSPEND_CREDENTIAL
operations.description: Lifts one suspension

errors.name: CredentialNotSuspendedError
errors.description: The credential is not suspended
